title: Select and materialize CAP-INV-101 bounded reuse-first capability wave
goal: Validate the fresh reuse-first-v1 selection of CAP-INV-101 against the canonical Case Queue contract and materialize exactly one bounded read-only queue implementation wave without performing Case lifecycle, assignment, export or Saved View mutations.
inputs: VERIFIED E10-SCALE-005A readiness and wave-selection evidence
canonical CAP-INV-101 Case Queue Product Spec contract
canonical Case, Incident, Finding and Shared Saved View objects
tenant, permission, pagination/filtering/sorting, Saved View, frontend-state and cross-product routing contracts
outputs: fresh source-backed confirmation of CAP-INV-101 selection
bounded read-only Case Queue implementation-wave manifest
invariants: verified product runtime code is not changed by scaling-control tasks
CAP-INV family preference does not imply runtime-boundary reuse
Case remains Investigate-owned, Incident remains Command-owned and Saved View remains Shared-owned
Case Queue does not become the Command Work Queue and never owns Tasks, Decisions or Response Runs
OPEN-013 governed assignment/lifecycle mutations remain excluded
final columns, final Case state machine, export backend, provider, storage and final UI are not invented
security_properties: selected canonical capability path must resolve inside the read-only Product Spec
tenant scope and Case read permission evaluation are deny-by-default
Saved View application is permission-re-evaluated and cannot expose forbidden fields
cross-tenant Case, Incident, Finding and Saved View projections are rejected
wave decomposition must split any task exceeding complexity budgets
acceptance_tests: canonical Case Queue capability file and referenced obligations resolve
assignment/lifecycle/export and Saved View mutation remain explicitly excluded
all generated child manifests pass strict-v2 and complexity validation
one first child is READY and all later children are dependency-gated

performance_budget.rationale: control-plane decomposition only; runtime budgets are compiled in the selected capability child work

migration.rationale: no product runtime or persistent data is changed

rollback.strategy: revert wave materialization without changing verified runtimes or ledger entries

definition_of_done: selection is exactly READY and source-backed
canonical CAP-INV-101 contract is reflected in a bounded read-only wave
child lots stay within complexity budgets
one next READY implementation task exists
